description: This file defines the UriResolver class which provides static methods for resolving and relativizing URI references according to RFC 3986. It includes methods for removing dot segments from paths, resolving relative URIs against base URIs, and generating relative references.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to resolve and relativize URI references.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a path string according to RFC 3986 section 5.2.4.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI to produce a new absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Generates a relative URI reference from a base URI to a target URI.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Calculates the relative path between two URIs.
